Lord '''Nefarid''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was one of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] of the ruthless [[Darth Angral]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What you're doing is twisted, even for Sith.''"<br />"''I enjoy life's simple pleasures. Don't judge me.|The Knight and Nefarid|<ref name="TOR:SM">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Siege Mentality|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Nefarid was in holoconference with his master and fellow apprentices as his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Angral]]'s son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], armed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Planet Prison]] to entrap [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Tarnis was interrupted and killed by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], whom Angral swore revenge upon. Nefarid added that they also control the Republic secret weapon projects for Angral to enact his revenge.

Upon learning of fellow apprentice [[Sadic]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Nefarid sent a message to the Knight congratulating the Jedi on defeating Sadic, thanking the Knight for eliminating one of his rivals for Angral's favor.<ref name="A Job">{{TORcite|type=message|A Job Well Done|Lord Nefarid}}</ref>

Nefarid journeyed to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], serving as an adviser to [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. He attacked the research facility where the [[Death Mark laser]] controls were being held. Despite [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]'s best efforts, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] managed to steal the equipment and trapped the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] within the facility. With aid of his spy [[Aleyna Hark]], Nefarid tagged and killed whomever he wished. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived, Nefarid killed [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Alde (Count)|Alde]], the [[Death Mark]] laser's financier, forcing the Jedi to race to Din's location. The Knight then started deactivating the generators powering the Death Mark laser to take the laser offline temporarily. When the Knight started with the primary generator, Nefarid called via holo, mocking the Knight's efforts by killing an innocent farm girl before the Knight reached the backup generator.

Nefarid's next target was [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Horis Thul]], an advocate of peace talks, forcing the Jedi to storm his compound to warn him. Despite the initial success, Aleyna managed to tag both Thul and the Knight. However, Thul gave the Knight Nefarid's location. Upon arriving, Nefarid showed the Knight a hologram of Angral executing Din to demoralize his opponent. He then emerged from the shadows and engaged the Knight with his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], all the while using the Death Mark laser on his opponent. Only the Knight's skill and use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] enabled the Jedi to evade the laser while killing Nefarid.
